pages.seoTitle: West LA Implants — Dental Implants, All-on-4 & Robotic Implant Surgery in Los Angeles
pages.seoDescription: West LA Implants is Dr. Tony Barriere's implant and cosmetic dentistry center on Wilshire Blvd, Los Angeles. Yomi robot-guided implant surgery, All-on-4 full arch, IV sedation and cosmetic dentistry under one roof.

props.text: 12301 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 205 · Los Angeles, CA 90025
West LA Implants · Wilshire Blvd, Los Angeles
An implant and cosmetic dentistry center built around precision, comfort and the person in the chair.
Missing teeth. A loose denture. An implant that failed somewhere else. You have probably been told this is complicated.
It is. Which is why it belongs with a dentist who does this every day, under one roof, with the tools to plan it before the first incision.
One tooth or several, planned in 3D and placed to last.
A fixed set of teeth on four implants. Often in a single day.
Robot-assisted guidance for the position, angle and depth of every implant.
Rebuilding the foundation first, when the jaw needs it.
Sleep through it. Wake up with the work done.
Veneers, whitening and Invisalign® for the finishing touch.
Not sure which is right for you?

props.text: The first robot built for implant surgery is in this room.
Yomi® guides the drill along the plan made from your own 3D scan. Diagnostics, planning, surgery and the final teeth all happen under one roof.

Dr. Barriere trained at The Ohio State University College of Dentistry and completed a yearlong surgical residency at NYU Langone Hospital. He has since logged more than a thousand hours of continuing education in implant and cosmetic dentistry.
